extraction.Name: Warren Real Rider
extraction.Recorded patent: yes, filed for record by allottee
extraction.Buyer: Sold to C. E. Vandervoort for $2000 which was a good price at that time. Did not owe purchaser any money.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes? no
extraction.Occupation/Income: No income from any source. Shares in Pawnee annuity.
extraction.NOTES: Good health. No property or money accumulated. Wife and two children dependent upon him. Date and manner of delivery of patent: 1917, Agency office. No evidence of fraud appears to have been practiced in this case. Notarized November 26, 1928; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929.

extraction.Name: Jesse Peters
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged to R. C. Spinning for $1700 then sold for $2000 allottee receiving but $65.00 for the land.
extraction.Buyer: Land sold for $2000 which the allottee thinks was $1000 below market value.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: It seems that the mortgage prevented him from receiving more money for the land.
extraction.Occupation/Income: No income from inherited land. Shares in Pawnee annuity.
extraction.NOTES: Bad eyesight. No property and no money accumulated. Wife and two children dependent upon him. Date and manner of delivery of patent: Jan. 1918, Agency Office. It is believed that the allottee did not receive full value for his land. Notarized November 26, 1928; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929. Signed with x mark.
